title: Technician charge-out does not offer or accept an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL TECHDESK) is a staff member at {Location-A} with the default Technician role, signed in in a second browser on a desktop computer.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TECHDESK-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL TECHDESK PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open and has an approved line, {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL TECHDESK line"), with {Technician-A} as a technician and no parts.
custom_steps:
1. As {Technician-A}, open {Work-order-1}.
  2. Under {Line-1} click "+ Add Part".
  3. In the new part row type the start of {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TECHD) in the part field.
  4. Clear the field and type {Part-A} in full, all in lower case.
  5. Press Enter (or click the row's "Save").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No row for {Part-A} is offered.
  • Step 4: The field shows, as its error, "{Part-A} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", with {Part-A} written as it was saved (capitals and hyphens). No offer to add it as a special order or a new part appears.
  • Step 5: The row is not saved: {Line-1} gets no new part and the error stays under the field.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R3, S9-R16, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.3 (Typing the retired number in full; the same message on New Part Request), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R3: “Technician charge-out part selection does not return inactive parts, on every device.”
  • S9-R16: “When the number typed in a part lookup matches an inactive part at this location, the lookup does not offer to add it as a special order. It shows "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", naming the inactive part's number. On technician charge-out, where a typed number is taken straight from the field, the field shows the same message as its error and the line cannot be saved.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Retired number typed in a part lookup): “"{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it." | Shown in the lookup in place of the special order offer; on technician charge-out, error under the field”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7, ListingQueryHandler: “Covers WO, estimate, tech charge-out (every device), PO, vendor-bill re-point, part sale”
